patches.title: Exhaust Countertop Pair
patches.principle: Always check both countertop 1 and countertop 2 before moving to other furniture.
patches.when_to_apply: When beginning search on countertop 1 and target not visible.

patches.title: Diningtable Before Appliances
patches.principle: After countertops, search diningtable before checking stoveburners, fridge, or sink.
patches.when_to_apply: When countertops are empty and target not found.

patches.title: Avoid Premature Sink Visit
patches.principle: Do not go to sink unless you are holding the target object to be cleaned.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have not yet acquired the target object.
